rule: Unauthorized and nonexistent catalog references have one indistinguishable error shape throughout records, aggregate, semantic, lexical, and hybrid paths.

pairedQueryTemplate.right: reference nonexistent {{referenceKind}} with same token length in {{mode}}

adversarialIntent: Repeat catalog enumeration guesses across every query path and compare complete result bytes, timings bucket, alternatives, and backend-call trace.

expansion.selection: One nextU32 per dimension in listed order; select values[word % values.length].

checks: The paired refusal result JCS bytes are identical.
Enumerated alternatives contain only in-scope catalog keys in one deterministic order.
Operational timing exposed to the caller is in the same declared bucket; exact nanosecond equality is not required.

gap: RFC §10 does not define the shared hidden/nonexistent code, message, path treatment, alternatives ordering, or a timing-disclosure policy.
